own_solution.law: Lorentz force in uniform B: cyclotron period T = 2 pi m/(q B), independent of speed; pitch p = v_parallel T
assumptions: uniform static B, no E field, gravity neglected

notes: T = 2 pi (5e-4 kg)/(5e-3 C * 0.8 T) = 2 pi * 0.125 s = 0.7854 s; pitch = 12 * 0.7854 = 9.425 m. With total charge 8.4 mC: T = 2 pi * 5e-4/(6.72e-3) = 0.4675 s; pitch = 5.610 m. Perpendicular speed sets the radius only and cancels from the period (C). Electroscope sentences D; earlier-run charge D. Pairs (3.4 mC) and (6.5 m/s) state the same numbers and units. A mC charge on a 0.5 g bead is large but irrelevant to the idealised problem.
